# Torque Studio · Design direction on subscription

> A lead designer and a head of operations on your team, not on your payroll. Design direction for product companies and consumer brands that need a lot of design, fast. Websites, campaigns and decks: thought through by hand, produced with AI in the engine room, shipped in days, not months. On subscription. One flat monthly fee, sized to your workload.

Torque Studio is a design studio on subscription, run by Pavlo Lobodiuk (Lead Brand Designer) and Anastasiia Odegova (Head of Operations), for product companies and consumer brands: a lead designer who owns the thinking, a head of operations who runs the queue and the deadlines, and an AI production engine that does the volume inside rules set by hand. Every piece is reviewed before it ships. Requests usually come back within 72 hours. The monthly fee is set individually, by scope.

## Services ("Everything your marketing runs on")

- **Landing pages & websites**: Designed, built, launched and kept up to date. No developers, no handoff, no waiting.
- **Ad creatives**: Several versions to test, not one pretty version.
- **Pitch decks**: Complex product stories made simple for investors and buyers.
- **Social media**: Posts, carousels, covers. Consistent every week.
- **Visuals & motion**: Product shots, campaign imagery, animated banners, short video.

## Work

Client work is under NDA. These five are concept brands built end to end, the way the studio builds yours: one idea carried through the identity, the website and the campaign.
- Running Shoes: Show the engineering, skip the hype.
- Architecture Firm: Feel the buildings before you meet the architect.
- Urban Sunglasses: Six frames. 640 pairs. Then gone.
- IT Company: A product you can’t see, made trustworthy.
- Beverage: A soda that explains itself.
